issues.on_page: Other 207,513 = General 101,045 + Street 88,510 + CCC Inn 218 + Fire 7,956 + Other Gov 9,784; schedules p14/p16 show NPPD lease 84,961 + 84,961 = 169,922 (82%) plus franchise fees 8,014
issues.issue: Broad 'Other' line whose make-up is printed in the fund schedules: NPPD lease (rentals) is more than half of it, so the rule requires the dominant category (Rentals) or a split_from split (NPPD lease 169,922 / franchise 8,014 / other remainder). It was left in 'other' instead.

issues.on_page: Street 'Motor vehicle fees' 13,646; Fire 'Rural Fire Department - cost share' 648,212
issues.issue: The remainder of Intergovernmental includes Street motor vehicle fees 13,646, which detail[55] records as motor vehicle tax (same money, different category), and the rural fire contract cost share 648,212 (59% of the remainder), which could be charges for services (rural fire contracts) rather than state aid.
Nebraska Mutual Finance Organization money is a state payment, so 'other state aid' fits better than county/other local governments.

User rule 2026-10-28 gives ambulance charges their own category, Ambulance Fees (detail_category already ambulance/rescue fees). user_rules.py matches labels only, so the generic label 'Charges for services' won't be re-categorized.
Park/pool charges (detail_category recreation/pool/park fees) belong to the user's own category, Recreation Fees. user_rules.py won't catch the generic label.

issues.on_page: NPPD lease 84,961 (General p14; also detail[57] Street p16)
issues.issue: Lease income (detail_category rentals) belongs to the user's own category, Rentals. The label 'NPPD lease' doesn't match user_rules.py's rental regex.

Enterprise user charges belong to the user's own category, Utility Charges. The receipt has no fund field, so user_rules.py won't map it. Recycling 'Charges for services' 1,000 (detail[86], refuse/sanitation charges) is the same case.
